<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1262
Claimant:
Matthew Hardy
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-03-25
Claim received for a collision at an intersection where the insured vehicle was turning left and was struck in the side
by another vehicle. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by an attorney.
2024-04-17
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
2024-04-30
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Responding officers
also noted the claimant's presence in the vehicle when they arrived.
2024-05-05
Reviewed the photographs taken at the scene. They confirm several details of the account, including the position of
the vehicles after impact.
2024-06-17
Inspected the vehicle damage. The pattern and location of the damage match the impact described by the claimant.
2024-06-26
Checked prior claim history on the vehicle and found no earlier damage to the same areas.
2024-07-31
Interviewed the claimant, who described the collision consistently with the first statement. The claimant added a few
minor details about the traffic signal and speed, but the core account has not changed.
2024-08-10
Searched for independent witnesses. None were identified, so the account rests on the photographs, the physical
damage, and the police findings.
2024-08-28
Reviewed the medical records. The shoulder injury is consistent in type and severity with the force of a side impact of
this kind.
2024-09-08
Noted that the claimant had a minor shoulder strain several years ago in the same area, which healed completely
with no lasting limitation. The current treatment has been assessed separately from that earlier episode.
2024-09-26
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. Symptoms and treatment frequency
have tapered as the claimant has improved.
2024-10-01
Current status: liability and damage are supported by the file, and the injury claim is being evaluated against the
treatment records and recovery progress. Reserve reviewed; file to remain open pending final medical update.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
